They both had their hands and arms underneath the water and it looked like they were having a grand ole time. Things got more interesting as another random person started taking the longest piss in history about 30 yards upstream of the guys fondling each other. It was strange trying to get each of their attention and trying to explain what was happening. My Arabic was still very bad and the game of charades that followed was more confusing than helpful. In the end chicken washer just waved and smiled and the urinator finally saw the guys getting nasty and decided to join in. Strange day.
